subject: Web Development
title: APIs: Connecting the Web
description: A quick win: understand APIs: Connecting the Web.

hook.text: In the early web, every site was an island. Data stayed locked inside each platform.

buildup.text: Web APIs opened doors, letting services expose their data through simple endpoints.

discovery.text: Developers combined maps, weather, and social data into new apps called mashups.

twist.text: Companies realized APIs were products. Twitter, Google, and Stripe built empires on them.

climax.text: Today the average web page makes dozens of API calls you never see.

punchline.text: APIs turned the web into a connected machine.
